Meet the kid

Kid Jensen is the kid version of the most famous leather jacket in tech — reimagined as a parody: same grey hair, same big dreams, about four feet tall.

He runs his empire from the cafeteria. The GPUs can wait until after lunch, the homework is “training data,” and the answer to every hard problem is the same one it has always been: eat first, then build.
